card.name: Alternate amounts in parentheses
card.fires_on: The amount word or number inside a parenthetical that restates a quantity, such as a half or quarter cup after ounces, or an alternative tablet count after 'or'.

modes.label: Cup equivalents
modes.description: A fraction in parentheses giving the cup equivalent of a stated number of ounces.

modes.label: Alternative dose after or
modes.description: A number right after 'or' offering another way to give the same dose.
modes.example: One dose (1 packet or <<1>> level teaspoon) of COLESTID
